title: deselect command
description:
## Overview

## Context

Companion to the select command. Allows users to remove snippets from their context set. Multiple IDs can be provided at once. Integrates with config management (issue 2).

contextkit deselect <id...> [options]

3. Remove IDs from selectedSnippets array
4. Save updated config
5. Display confirmation with snippet titles

Removed 2 snippets from selection:
  - [snippet-123] Authentication Flow
  - [snippet-456] Database Connection

- [ ] Handles IDs that aren't in selection gracefully (no error)

title: search command
description:
## Overview

Implement `contextkit search <query>` command for semantic search across all snippets using vector similarity.

## Context

This is the core search functionality that allows users to find relevant snippets using natural language queries. Uses the vector search implementation from contextkit-clr (Epic 3) to perform similarity search with embeddings.

## Files to Create

- `/packages/cli/src/commands/search.ts` - Search command implementation

## Implementation Details

Command signature:
```
contextkit search <query> [options]
```

Options:
- `--limit <n>` - Number of results to return (default: 10)
- `--threshold <n>` - Minimum similarity score (default: 0.7)
- `--json` - Output as JSON

Workflow:
1. Accept query string from user
2. Call vector search function from Epic 3 (contextkit-clr)
3. Format results with snippet ID, title, similarity score, preview
4. Support both human-readable and JSON output

Output format (plain text):
```
Found 5 results:

1. [snippet-123] Authentication Flow (0.92)
   File: /packages/auth/src/login.ts
   Preview: "Handles user login with JWT tokens..."

2. [snippet-456] Database Connection (0.87)
   ...
```

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `contextkit search "user authentication"` returns relevant results
- [ ] Results sorted by similarity score (highest first)
- [ ] --limit option controls number of results
- [ ] --threshold option filters by minimum score
- [ ] --json outputs structured JSON with all fields
- [ ] Shows helpful message when no results found
- [ ] Handles empty query gracefully

## Dependencies

- Depends on: contextkit-clr (vector search implementation)
- Depends on: CLI entry (issue 1) for command registration

## Parent Epic

contextkit-2tq (Epic 4: CLI)

## Plan Reference

~/.claude/plans/peaceful-waddling-blossom.md - Epic 4

title: Epic: Shared Library
description:
## Overview
Build the shared library (`packages/shared`) containing database client, TypeScript types, embeddings utilities, and vector search.

## Context
This package is the core of ContextKit - both the web app and CLI depend on it. It provides:
- SQLite database client with platform-specific paths
- Type definitions for Snippet, SnippetVersion, ProjectConfig
- Local embeddings using transformers.js (all-MiniLM-L6-v2)
- Vector similarity search using sqlite-vss

## Key Files
- `/packages/shared/src/types.ts` - TypeScript interfaces
- `/packages/shared/src/db/client.ts` - SQLite connection management
- `/packages/shared/src/db/schema.ts` - Table definitions & migrations
- `/packages/shared/src/db/vectors.ts` - sqlite-vss integration
- `/packages/shared/src/embeddings.ts` - transformers.js wrapper

## Tech Stack
- better-sqlite3 for SQLite
- sqlite-vss for vector similarity search
- @xenova/transformers for local embeddings (cached at ~/.cache/huggingface/)

## Database Location
- macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/contextkit/contextkit.db
- Linux: ~/.local/share/contextkit/contextkit.db
- Windows: %APPDATA%/contextkit/contextkit.db

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Types exported and usable by web/cli packages
- [ ] DB client creates database at correct platform-specific path
- [ ] Schema creates tables: snippets, snippet_versions, snippet_embedding_map
- [ ] sqlite-vss extension loads and creates virtual table
- [ ] Embeddings generate 384-dim vectors for text
- [ ] Vector search returns scored results

## Plan Reference
See: `~/.claude/plans/peaceful-waddling-blossom.md`

title: Epic: CLI
description:
## Overview
Build the CLI tool (`packages/cli`) that AI coding agents use to discover, search, and select context snippets for projects.

## Context
The CLI is designed for AI agents to use programmatically. It reads from the same SQLite database as the web app. All commands support `--json` output for machine consumption.

## Commands (8 total)
1. `contextkit onboard` - Output setup instructions for AI agents
2. `contextkit search <query>` - Semantic search for snippets
3. `contextkit snippet <id>` - Fetch single snippet by ID
4. `contextkit select <id...>` - Add snippets to project config
5. `contextkit deselect <id...>` - Remove snippets from project config
6. `contextkit list` - Show currently selected snippets
7. `contextkit generate` - Output combined markdown for selected snippets
8. `contextkit doctor` - Run diagnostics on DB, embeddings, config

## Project Config
Stored at `.contextkit/config.json` in each project root:
```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "selectedSnippets": [
    { "id": "abc123", "title": "typescript-strict", "selectedAt": "..." }
  ]
}
```

## Key Files
- `/packages/cli/src/index.ts` - Entry point, Commander setup
- `/packages/cli/src/commands/*.ts` - Individual command implementations
- `/packages/cli/src/lib/config.ts` - Project config management

## Tech Stack
- Commander.js for CLI framework
- @contextkit/shared for database/embeddings access

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All 8 commands implemented and working
- [ ] All commands support --json flag
- [ ] Project config persists across sessions
- [ ] Search returns semantically relevant results
- [ ] Doctor validates entire stack

## Plan Reference
See: `~/.claude/plans/peaceful-waddling-blossom.md`

title: Live preview component for markdown rendering
description:
## Overview
Create a component that renders markdown content to HTML in real-time. This component displays the live preview of the markdown being edited in the SnippetEditor component.

## Context
Users need to see how their markdown will render while they write. This component takes raw markdown as input and outputs rendered HTML using a markdown parser (remark/rehype ecosystem or similar).

## Files to Create
- `/packages/web/src/components/MarkdownPreview.tsx` - Preview component that renders markdown to HTML

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Accepts markdown string as prop
- [ ] Renders markdown to HTML in real-time (updates as user types)
- [ ] Supports common markdown features: headings, bold, italic, links, images, code blocks, lists, blockquotes
- [ ] Syntax highlighting for code blocks (use highlight.js or prism.js)
- [ ] Safe HTML rendering (sanitize to prevent XSS attacks)
- [ ] Scrolls independently from editor pane
- [ ] Styled to match application theme
- [ ] Handles empty/invalid markdown gracefully
- [ ] Performance: debounce or throttle rendering if needed for long documents

## Dependencies
- **Depends on:** contextkit-746 (Markdown editor component - preview is displayed in right pane)

## Parent Epic
contextkit-744 (Epic 3: Web App)

## Plan Reference
~/.claude/plans/peaceful-waddling-blossom.md - Epic 3: Web App

## Implementation Notes
- Recommended: Use `remark` + `rehype` ecosystem for parsing
  - `remark-parse` (markdown → mdast)
  - `remark-rehype` (mdast → hast)
  - `rehype-stringify` (hast → HTML)
  - `rehype-sanitize` (XSS protection)
  - `rehype-highlight` (code syntax highlighting)
- Alternative: Use `marked` or `markdown-it` libraries
- Use `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` with sanitized HTML or render React components
- Consider using `react-markdown` for simpler implementation
- Apply GitHub-flavored markdown styles for familiar appearance

title: doctor command
description:
## Overview

Implement `contextkit doctor` command to diagnose system health: database connectivity, embeddings model availability, and project configuration.

## Context

The doctor command is critical for troubleshooting. It should check all dependencies and provide actionable suggestions when issues are found. This helps users verify their ContextKit installation is working correctly.

## Files to Create

- `/packages/cli/src/commands/doctor.ts` - Doctor command implementation

## Implementation Details

Checks to perform:
1. **Database Connection**
   - Connect to SQLite database using db client from contextkit-0v7
   - Verify tables exist (snippets, embeddings)
   - Report database location and size
   
2. **Embeddings Model**
   - Check if text-embedding-3-small is accessible
   - Test with sample embedding generation
   - Report model version/status
   
3. **Project Config**
   - Check if .contextkit/config.json exists
   - Validate config schema
   - Report number of selected snippets

Output format:
- Plain text: Checkmarks/crosses with colored output
- JSON mode: Structured results with status codes

## Acceptance Criteria

title: Create DB schema (snippets, versions)
description:
## Overview
Implement the database schema for snippets, versions, and embedding mappings with migration support.

## Context
The schema follows the spec in project.md. We store tags as JSON text. Versions are created automatically on every save.

## File to Create

### /packages/shared/src/db/schema.ts
```typescript
import { Database } from 'better-sqlite3';

/**
 * Initialize database schema
 */
export function initSchema(db: Database): void {
  db.exec(\`
    -- Snippets table
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS snippets (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      title TEXT NOT NULL,
      content TEXT NOT NULL,
      tags TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    );

    -- Snippet versions for history
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS snippet_versions (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      snippet_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      title TEXT NOT NULL,
      content TEXT NOT NULL,
      tags TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY (snippet_id) REFERENCES snippets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    );

    -- Mapping table for snippet <-> embedding
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS snippet_embedding_map (
      snippet_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      rowid INTEGER NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY (snippet_id) REFERENCES snippets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    );

    -- Indexes for common queries
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_snippets_updated_at ON snippets(updated_at);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_versions_snippet_id ON snippet_versions(snippet_id);
  \`);
}

/**
 * Check if schema is initialized
 */
export function isSchemaInitialized(db: Database): boolean {
  const result = db.prepare(
    "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='snippets'"
  ).get();
  return result !== undefined;
}
```

## Schema Notes
- UUIDs stored as TEXT (SQLite has no native UUID type)
- Tags stored as JSON array in TEXT column
- Timestamps stored as ISO 8601 strings
- Foreign keys with ON DELETE CASCADE for cleanup
- Indexes on frequently queried columns

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All tables created correctly

- [ ] Indexes created for performance

title: Snippet CRUD API routes
description:
## Overview
Create Next.js API routes for snippet CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete). These routes will serve as the backend API for the web application to interact with the PostgreSQL database.

## Context
This is the foundational API layer for Epic 3 (Web App). All UI components will interact with the database through these routes. The routes must implement proper error handling, validation, and return appropriate HTTP status codes.

## Files to Create
- `/packages/web/src/app/api/snippets/route.ts` - Handles GET (list all snippets) and POST (create snippet)
- `/packages/web/src/app/api/snippets/[id]/route.ts` - Handles GET (fetch single snippet), PUT (update snippet), DELETE (delete snippet)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] GET /api/snippets returns array of all snippets with metadata (id, title, tags, created_at, updated_at)
- [ ] POST /api/snippets accepts {title, tags, content} and creates new snippet, returns created snippet with id
- [ ] GET /api/snippets/[id] returns single snippet with full content
- [ ] PUT /api/snippets/[id] accepts {title, tags, content} and updates existing snippet, creates new version
- [ ] DELETE /api/snippets/[id] soft-deletes snippet (sets deleted_at timestamp)
- [ ] All routes return proper HTTP status codes (200, 201, 400, 404, 500)
- [ ] Request validation for required fields (title, content)
- [ ] Error responses include helpful error messages in JSON format

## Dependencies
- **Depends on:** contextkit-dlr (DB schema must be implemented first)
- **Blocks:** contextkit-745 (Dashboard page), contextkit-746 (Create snippet page), contextkit-747 (Edit snippet page)

## Plan Reference

## Implementation Notes
- Use Prisma client for database operations
- Implement proper TypeScript types for request/response bodies
- Follow Next.js 15 App Router conventions
- Consider implementing query parameters for GET /api/snippets (e.g., ?tags=foo&search=bar)
